description: SkyMind Copilot Milestone A Golden Evaluation Benchmark Dataset v2.0
notes: total_records and the tier counts are the number of records golden.jsonl actually contains; DatasetLoader cross-checks total_records on every load and records a mismatch as a schema error, which invalidates the run.
The counts here were previously 120 / smoke 25 / nightly 120 / regression 20 against a corpus of 15. Nothing read this file, so those figures propagated into backend/evals/README.md as documentation.
'full' is 15 rather than 9 because DatasetLoader treats tier='full' as 'every record', not as 'records tagged full'.

'nightly' and 'regression' are advertised as --tier choices by run.py but no record carries either tag, so both tiers load zero records and the run reports FAIL/INVALID. Adversarial cases are marked with the per-record boolean 'regression' (2 records) rather than with a tier.
